title: uri_to_iri and iri_to_uri drop an empty username or password
author: nyxst4ck
body_preview: `uri_to_iri()` and `iri_to_uri()` reconstruct the userinfo part of a URL using a truthiness check on `username` / `password`. Because an empty string is falsy, an empty-but-present username or password is silently dropped, even though `urllib.parse.urlsplit` distinguishes a present-but-empty component (`""`) from a missing one (`None`).
